purpose: Real result of dispatching .github/workflows/biotech-sponsor-scan.yml, connecting Milestone 3 Phase C's classifiers to the 6 of this project's own 23 accepted issuers whose real SEC-registered SIC code puts them in drug or medical-device development (config/m3-biotech-sponsor-map.json).
independent_cross_check: Every number above was separately reproduced by hand (plain urllib, not this project's code) against the live APIs on 2026-09-30 before this workflow was ever dispatched: NBIX's 4 FDA matches are INGREZZA, INGREZZA SPRINKLE and CRENESSITY (x2 submissions) under openFDA's own short sponsor_name 'NEUROCRINE'; COLL's 4 are XTAMPZA ER, NUCYNTA (x2) and NUCYNTA ER under 'COLLEGIUM PHARM INC'; TECX/ASMB/ACHV's 0 FDA matches were confirmed as real HTTP 404 zero-result searches, consistent with all three being clinical-stage with nothing FDA-approved yet; LNSR's 4-of-5 clinical-trials match is the same 4 real 'LensAR Incorporated' studies found by hand, with the 1 non-match being a real but unrelated 'Center For Sight' study that only matched the broad sponsor search.
context: None of the 68 events in config/m2-combined-events.json is itself a clinical-trial-result or FDA-action announcement -- every one is a plain earnings release (verified by reading each event's own real wire headline before building anything). So this connection is issuer-level, not event-level: these real trials/applications are separate, dated regulatory context for 6 of the 23 issuers, not a label, score, or reaction driver for any specific M1/M2 event. Full per-study/per-application classified detail (out/biotech-sponsor-scan.json on the runner) is not uploaded as a workflow artifact and does not survive the job, matching every other M3 workflow's own established pattern -- only the printed by_issuer summary above is a durable record of this specific dispatch.
not_a_claim: Not a claim that these are the only real trials/applications each company has -- clinical_trials_sponsor_search() caps at pageSize=20 per issuer; ASMB's 20-of-20 result means the true count is >= 20, undercounted here, not fabricated as complete.

Not a claim that a 'matched' study or application is scientifically or commercially significant, or that a 'not matched' one is irrelevant -- lead_sponsor_match/sponsor_match only says whether ClinicalTrials.gov's/openFDA's own recorded sponsor name plausibly is this issuer; every result is classified and shown either way, never silently dropped.

Not a claim that TECX/ASMB/ACHV have no regulatory activity at all -- zero openFDA matches for these three real, clinical-stage companies means nothing has reached FDA-approved status yet, not that no application was ever filed (Drugs@FDA only covers approved/tentatively-approved applications).

Not a claim that LNSR's device-related FDA activity was checked -- Drugs@FDA (NDA/ANDA/BLA) does not apply to a medical-device company; a real device clearance/approval would need a separate openFDA endpoint (api.fda.gov/device/) this project does not classify yet.
